rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something characteristic of Shakespeare or derived from his style or works.

example.english: The dialogue in this play is very Shakespearean and sounds wonderfully classical.
example.traditional: 呢套舞台劇嘅對白好莎士比亞式，聽落好有古典味。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 mou5 toi1 kek6 ge3 deoi3 baak6 hou2 saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 sik1 teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 gu2 din2 mei6

rows.jyutping: saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for something belonging to, associated with, or directly concerning Shakespeare, his works, or his authorship rather than merely resembling his style.

example.traditional: 我哋今日睇咗莎士比亞嘅《哈姆雷特》。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 tai2 zo2 saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 ge3 haa1 mou5 leoi4 dak6

rows.traditional: 改編自莎士比亞作品嘅 + N
rows.jyutping: goi2 pin1 zi6 saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 zok3 ban2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this specifically for a work or thing adapted or derived from one of Shakespeare's works.

example.english: This film is a modern love story adapted from a Shakespearean work.
example.traditional: 呢套電影係改編自莎士比亞作品嘅現代愛情故事。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 hai6 goi2 pin1 zi6 saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 zok3 ban2 ge3 jin6 doi6 oi3 cing4 gu3 si6
